Runtime (unmodified):

Bloom addons (one edit each: the bare `from 'three'` specifier is rewritten to
`from '../three.module.js'` so they load without an import map):
  package/examples/jsm/postprocessing/{EffectComposer,RenderPass,UnrealBloomPass,
    ShaderPass,OutputPass,Pass,MaskPass}.js -> postprocessing/
  package/examples/jsm/shaders/{CopyShader,LuminosityHighPassShader,OutputShader}.js
    -> shaders/

These are vendored so the landing scene has no remote module import or runtime
CDN dependency. Refresh them only by copying the same files from a pinned npm
tarball, re-applying the specifier rewrite, and updating this record.
